_comment: Public training logs rldoctor is validated against. Raw logs are downloaded into validation/.cache/ (gitignored) by fetch.py and never committed: they belong to their authors. `expect` pins the verdict at WARNING or above, so a change that alters a real-run verdict fails `python validation/run.py --check`.

runs.what_is_true: Every rollout hit the 8192-token cap: completions/clipped_ratio has a minimum of 0.992 over the run and completions/mean_terminated_length is 0 throughout. Gradient norms are all finite.
29% of optimiser steps log a gradient norm of exactly 0.0; seven genuine spikes up to 24x the median; training reward flat over the last third.
Short (80-step) run with tightly clustered gradient norms -- the largest is 2x the median, which is not a spike. Nothing warrants a warning.
88% of optimiser steps log a gradient norm of exactly 0.0, rising from 40% in the first quarter to 93% in the last. frac_reward_zero_std is not logged.
